pli-tv-bi-vb-np6:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np6:1.2: tena kho pana samayena upāsakā bhikkhunīsaṅghassa cīvaratthāya chandakaṃ saṅgharitvā aññatarassa pāvārikassa ghare parikkhāraṃ nikkhipitvā bhikkhuniyo upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-np6:1.3: amukassa ayye pāvārikassa ghare cīvaratthāya parikkhāro nikkhitto tato cīvaraṃ āharāpetvā bhājethāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np6:1.4: bhikkhuniyo tena parikkhārena sayaṃ bhesajjaṃ cetāpetvā paribhuñjiṃsu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np6:1.6: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena saṅghikena aññaṃ cetāpessantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np6:1.7: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ upāsakānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np6:1.8: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-np6:1.9: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena saṅghikena aññaṃ cetāpessantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-np6:1.10: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena saṅghikena aññaṃ cetāpentīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np6:1.13: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena saṅghikena aññaṃ cetāpessanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-np6:1.15: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-np6:1.16.1: yā pana bhikkhunī aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena saṅghikena aññaṃ cetāpeyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np6:2.1.10: yaṃ atthāya dinnaṃ taṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ cetāpeti payoge dukkaṭaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-np6:2.1.12: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā ekabhikkhuniyā vā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np6:2.1.15: idaṃ me ayye aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena saṅghikena aññaṃ cetāpitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ imāhaṃ saṅghassa nissajjāmīti
pli-tv-bi-vb-np6:2.2.1: aññadatthike aññadatthikasaññā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np6:2.2.2: aññadatthike vematikā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np6:2.2.3: aññadatthike anaññadatthikasaññā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
